source_snapshot: Source hashes were captured after the audit, before the 2.1.0 release metadata bump. Cargo.toml declared 2.0.2 at measurement; runtime source is unchanged by the release bump.
timing_scope: Serial synthetic trials on one logical CPU, no overlapping builds or profilers. Lookup/open bytes already in memory; external builds create fresh temporary files. Live desktop not an isolated performance host; frequency, scheduler, filesystem cache and other programs are not fully controlled. Descriptive paired trials, not production latency or hardware-counter evidence.

baseline_provenance.description: Complete deduplication precursor was uncommitted; unlike the earlier cache-only revision, it already produces the same deduplicated artifact. Source archived locally in target/perf-study/before/netindex-before.crate; not included in repository. Old AVX search matches that revision.
baseline_provenance.source_note: Width binaries predate simd-utf8 feature factoring. Final index binaries include it. A subsequently removed redundant u64 cast has no semantic or machine-code effect; final checks use the corrected source.

dedup.invariants: All 100000 independent query oracles passed; both artifacts byte-identical to in-memory Builder: 1926943 bytes, logical temporary peak 9926855, retained payload key bytes 4086. Includes push+finish, excludes setup/validation/oracle. Logical bytes exclude RSS, allocator and filesystem cache.

profiling.scope: Separate eight-process whole-program ETW captures, not CPU-pinned; includes oracle/setup/finalization. Overlapping inclusive samples must not be added or treated as elapsed-time shares. Private PDB symbols resolved with LLVM symbolizer; not hardware counters. Positioned capture may overlap independent cross-compilation. Timing conclusions use separate serial trials.

assembly.observation: Before: runtime-width division, runtime decode and u128 comparison. After: four width-specialized kernels, unsigned u64 scalar narrowing, no division, appropriate vpcmpgt{b,w,d,q}, vpmovmskb and vzeroupper. Baseline Cell::at called Seek::seek then Read::read; positioned implementation is inlined and uses FileExt absolute-offset I/O.

width_study.mix: 50% deterministic hits, 50% gaps; address assertions with four-byte insertion-id payload; independent prechecks verify ids, original targets and borrowed bytes. Asserts actual encoded width.
width_study.input_hash_encoding: netindex-search-width-v1 NUL; IPv6 boolean u8; width u8; record count LE u32; each row address LE u128, insertion id LE u32, payload LE u32; then each effective query LE u128.
width_study.decision: Keep optional specialized AVX2 kernels; scalar still generally wins. Width16 uses unchanged scalar code. Do not enable AVX2 by default or add unmeasured NEON/AVX512/128-bit kernels.

builds.control: Cargo bench profile inherits repository release codegen-units=1; debug=1, no explicit LTO override
builds.pgo: Same code as control; profile-use from synthetic lookup/open training; no added ThinLTO

application_build_study.training: Instrumented index benchmark --bench --profile-time 1 ^(lookup|open)/ on CPU20. Setup/correctness checks also exercise JSON; JSON timings are omitted from training, not a wholly unseen workload. Not real traffic. Separate training and measurement runs use same deterministic distributions.
application_build_study.llvm_profdata: Bundled Rust 1.95.0 llvm-profdata (LLVM22.1.2), matching profile producer
application_build_study.input_hash_encoding: netindex-index-v1 NUL, scenario ASCII NUL, count LE u32; each record tag u8 (address=0,network=1,range=2,asn=3), family u8 (0,4,6), start LE u128, range end LE u128 or 0, prefix u8 or 0, insertion id LE u32, payload LE u64=42. Then effective queries: family u8, address/ASN LE u128. Metadata benchmark.
application_build_study.decision: PGO merits a consuming-application trial on representative traffic, especially validation/opening. ThinLTO is mixed; measure rather than assume. No library-default build-policy change. PGO plus ThinLTO, actual HTTP latency and cold file I/O not measured.

excluded_experiments: CPU2 width runs showed multi-fold variation in unchanged width16 control and are excluded; CPU2 PGO/control and early broad-screen runs are exploratory only. Raw local target/perf-study and Criterion files retained. Final CPU20 trials still contain variability; report both passes.
not_measured: Real City conversion or minimum converted size
Cold-disk behavior, concurrent readers, production p95/p99
CPU cycles, branch or cache hardware counters
Payload frequency/reuse-distance distribution on real provider input

verification.not_run: Remote CI; non-Windows runtime tests; hardware cycle/branch/cache counters
